❯ Write a 2000 word detailed essay about the history of computing, very long and thorough.

● A History of Computing

  Origins: Counting Before Machines

  The history of computing begins long before electricity, transistors, or even the concept of a "machine" in the modern sense. At its root, computing is about manipulating information according to rules, and humans have
  been doing that for millennia. The earliest computational aids were physical: tally sticks notched to record quantities, knotted cords like the Andean quipu, and pebbles arranged in grooves. The abacus, which emerged
  in various forms across Mesopotamia, China, and Rome more than two thousand years ago, represented a profound conceptual leap. It externalized arithmetic, allowing a trained operator to perform calculations faster and
  more reliably than mental computation alone. The abacus endured for centuries precisely because it embodied an enduring principle: that representing numbers physically and operating on those representations by fixed
  procedures could amplify human cognitive capacity.

  Mathematics itself advanced the theory of computation. The development of positional number systems—especially the Hindu-Arabic decimal system with its revolutionary use of zero—made systematic calculation tractable.
  The word "algorithm" derives from the name of the ninth-century Persian mathematician al-Khw
